page.overview:
Who is Avisaurus?

(meaning "bird lizard") is an extinct genus of enantiornithine bird from the Late Cretaceous of North America.

It is known to have lived in the Hell Creek Formation, where it is inhabited by Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, Pachycephalosaurus, Struthiomimus, and Ankylosaurus.

Avisaurus appears in the Jurassic World Dominion Projector Kit from the Smithsonian Museum where it is showcased in an illustration alongside Troodon.
